ideas.title: Investigation into Voter Records in Minnesota
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the subpoenaing of the Minnesota elections office and the probe into non-citizens on state voter rolls.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and data analysis to uncover potential election irregularities.
questions: What are the findings of the investigation?
How widespread is the issue of non-citizens on voter rolls?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of election fraud or irregularities in Minnesota or other states.

ideas.title: Childcare Fraud Schemes on the Rise
ideas.description: An examination of the recent cases of childcare fraud schemes, including the sentencing of a Pennsylvania man and the charging of a Brooklyn daycare director.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records to identify potential connections between the cases.
questions: What are the commonalities among the cases?
ideas.insight: This story could identify a larger pattern of childcare fraud, potentially involving multiple individuals or organizations.
